text:
Lena Ortiz: Heads up — Catalyst Labs (reseller trial) wants a one-off onboarding package: 6-month prepaid credits $60,000, a 40% reseller discount on first invoice only, waive the $2,000 onboarding fee, and a 10% rev-share paid monthly. They asked for net-30 terms (instead of our standard net-30 -> they'd like accelerated provisioning). Need finance + legal approval for exception and GL mapping. cc @Will Harper @Sofia Ramos

Will Harper: Quick clarifying Qs: is this Hosted API? What's the payment method? Also need COGS estimate to run margin impact. We generally avoid 40% first-invoice discounts unless there's a strategic reason.

Lena Ortiz: Hosted API, payment via ACH. They argue the big discount is promotional to drive 3 pilot customers and justify waived onboarding. Expected run-rate post-promo ~ $95k ARR. Infra COGS estimate from Sofia: ~$10k over the 6 months (hosted).

Sofia Ramos: Confirmed COGS estimate based on token model p50. Does not include dedicated SRE support — add if requested. For the waived onboarding fee, ops recommends we require a signed SOW that lists expected hours to avoid open-ended work.

Rana Singh: Legal: For waiver we need explicit language in the reseller addendum limiting scope of onboarding (hours cap), and a clause that promotional discount applies only once and is non-recurring. Also include tax responsibility language and audit rights. I can draft addendum once commercial terms fixed.

billing-bot: Created ticket BILL-4999: "Catalyst Labs reseller promo setup" — tasks: new plan_id 'catalyst-prepromo-v1', invoice template with one-time promo line, GL mapping for reseller_reserve (5122). Link: https://redwood.internal/billing/BILL-4999

Will Harper: Finance guardrails: (1) For net-30 prepaid under $75k exposure OK with reserve 20%; (2) We should cap promo discount impact to protect gross margin, suggest we treat the 40% as a marketing rebate recorded contra-revenue rather than permanent price change; (3) Rev-share of 10% on gross vs net? Prefer net after platform fees.

Sofia Ramos: Works for us — rev-share net after platform fees is fine. COGS stands. We'll flag any PS needs separately.

Lena Ortiz: If finance is okay with reserve + contra-revenue treatment, Catalyst agrees to sign the SOW and wire now. They also request monthly payout cadence for rev-share.

Will Harper: Treasury: provisional approval pending creation of GL 5122 for reseller_reserve. Reserve 20% of prepaid into 5122. Approve waiving onboarding fee contingent on SOW with capped hours and contra-revenue accounting for promo (one-time). Approve net-30 invoicing and monthly rev-share payouts. :white_check_mark:

Rana Singh: I'll prepare addendum with promo carve-outs, onboarding hours cap, tax/KYC and audit language. Need Lena to attach signed SOW to BILL-4999.

Lena Ortiz: Will attach SOW + ACH confirmation to BILL-4999 and loop Partnerships for reference. billing-bot please tag plan 'catalyst-prepromo-v1' and move to high priority for billing config.

billing-bot: Updated BILL-4999: plan tag 'catalyst-prepromo-v1' added, invoice template attached, GL 5122 created. Next steps: legal signoff -> billing config -> create customer credit account -> schedule monthly payout job. ETA 2 business days for initial config.
